dialogues.speaker: Shenhe
dialogues.text: Liyue Harbor by night is even brighter than Mt. Aocang by day.

dialogues.speaker: Shenhe
dialogues.text: I couldn't get used to this view at first. But I'm told this is how it always looks at the Lantern Rite. I guess everyone likes brightly lit places, because every time you mention Lantern Rite, people can't help but smile.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Yes, that's the Lantern Rite smile.

dialogues.speaker: Shenhe
dialogues.text: #Will you be staying here for good now, {NICKNAME}?

dialogues.speaker: Shenhe
dialogues.text: Well... it's nice to see you.

dialogues.speaker: Shenhe
dialogues.text: If Lantern Rite could continue indefinitely... that would be even better.
